worked_solution:
First, we convert the given probability into a cumulative probability using the complement:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -1) & =P(X<-1) \\  & =1-P(X\ge -1) \\  & =1-0.5793 \\  & =0.4207\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we transform to a standard normal random variable by $z$-scoring:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\le -1) & =0.4207 \\ P(Z\le \frac{-1-\mu }{5}) & =0.4207 \\ Φ(\frac{-1-\mu }{5}) & =0.4207 \\ \frac{-1-\mu }{5} & ={Φ}^{-1}(0.4207)\end{aligned}
$$

 

According to the table, we have

$$
Φ(-0.2)=0.4207\,⇒\,{Φ}^{-1}(0.4207)=-0.2.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-1-\mu }{5} & =-0.2 \\ -1-\mu  & =-1 \\ \mu  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
